tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background — the apron. Light: dry concrete; dark: night asphalt.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels (DataPlate, ProjectCard body, inputs). Always sits on `ground`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `ground` and `surface` (15:1+ both themes). Also hard shadows and marking outlines in light.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions on `ground` and `surface` (6.6:1+ both themes). Also control borders (inputs, ghost buttons) at 3:1+.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around panels. Never the only thing separating two controls — pair with spacing.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Airfield sign yellow. Fills only in light theme (1.3:1 on ground — never text there). In dark theme it may also be text or linework on `ground` (11.7:1). Direction signs, secondary buttons, markings, the Cover.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Legend text and arrows on a `signal` fill (11.4:1), both themes.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Location-sign plate: primary buttons, the current-page panel of a SignArray, the mark. In dark theme it is set off from `ground` by its `signal` inset border, not by shade.

tokens.name: on-plate
tokens.usage: Legend and inset border on a `plate` (11.4:1 light, 12.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Mandatory-instruction red. Fill only: hold-short banners, destructive or irreversible actions, the one 'stop here' per page.

tokens.name: on-hold
tokens.usage: Legend text on a `hold` fill (6.2:1).

tokens.name: hold-ink
tokens.usage: Red as TEXT: validation errors, 'offline' labels, on `ground` and `surface` (5.7:1+ light, 7.0:1+ dark).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Taxiway-edge-light blue. Inline links and the focus ring on `ground` and `surface` (5.5:1+ light, 7.6:1+ dark). Nothing else is blue.

tokens.name: lamp-go
tokens.usage: Centreline-light green: 'available', 'online', 'shipped'. As text or lamp on `ground`/`surface` (5.1:1+ light, 8.3:1+ dark). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: lamp-caution
tokens.usage: Caution lamp: 'in progress'. A lamp dot only (in light theme it is outlined in `ink`); the word beside it carries the meaning.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px so it lands on the ground around the control, never on the control's own fill.

families.mono: "Martian Mono Variable", "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page, the hero statement. Set at font-stretch 118% (expanded). 5 words max; mobile drops to `h1`.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: NavFusion — sensor fusion for UAV navigation

styles.name: sign
styles.usage: Sign legends: UPPERCASE, condensed (font-stretch 82%). Nav, buttons, section markers.

styles.name: sign-sm
styles.usage: Small sign legends: compact buttons, LangSwitch. Condensed 82%.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I build control systems, simulation pipelines and ML tools — now moving from aircraft to robots.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a display or h1. Max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The estimator fuses IMU and GNSS at 200 Hz and degrades gracefully when the fix drops.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE keys: DataPlate keys, kickers above headings, tag text. Never sentences.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Values, dates, coordinates, metrics. Tabular figures.

spacing.note: An 8:5 (Fibonacci ×4) scale after Katarzyna Kobro's spatial compositions: each step ≈1.6× the last, so gaps read as deliberate jumps, never nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, lamp-to-word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, gap inside a SignArray.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, row padding in DataPlate.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, card inner padding (mobile), page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between a heading block and its content; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero top/bottom; before the contact holding line.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: panels, cards, tags, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: Sign plates and buttons — a pressed-metal edge, not a soft corner.

tokens.name: radius-lamp
tokens.usage: Lamps (status dots) only. Nothing else is round.

shadow.note: No blur, ever. Shadows are hard offsets, like a plate standing off a wall.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Resting state of everything.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover / focus-within on ProjectCard and primary Button: the plate lifts 2px up-left while this shadow appears.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: `rule` hairlines.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Control borders, focus ring, ProjectCard frame.

tokens.name: stroke-sign
tokens.usage: Inset border of a location sign (plate).

layout.note: Constructivist split: major and minor columns in 8:5.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page frame.

tokens.name: split-major
tokens.usage: Major column of an 8:5 split (text, project list).

tokens.name: split-minor
tokens.usage: Minor column of an 8:5 split (DataPlate, aside).
